$Comment: The way into Harvest Feast: go and find Martha the Cook in the Forgotten Temple. It arms itself:
Flow.AutoAccept puts it in every player's quest log while the feast runs, at their next login or
world change, and the base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at the giver: nothing to bring, only the
walk. Martha's conversation opens on her arrival line while it is carried, and its answer hands it
in. Its pay is a Claim like every quest's, so the hand-in takes the player to her quest list with
Collect in front of them; collecting it plays her conversation again, and its beat with the OnceId
meet_wheat_offer opens on her first quest's offer. A player whose quest log was full when it tried to
arm takes it from the same arrival line, through its quest row.
Its Parent's Season hides it while the feast is off, so its own Requires holds only the Not group,
which keeps it from anyone who already finished Wheat for the Ovens. With no Repeat it comes once per
player, ever. Wheat for the Ovens does not wait on it: a player without it still gets the questline
from Martha. It pays a few festival tokens through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet
has no item to hand over.
Beside the tokens, MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row pays Acrobatics XP for the walk to the temple,
collected with the rest. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a
server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the tokens still pay.
Name: Martha_Meet
